snippet.title: Spooky market trailer
snippet.description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.
